name: js-glob
instruction: Implement globMatch.js (CommonJS): module.exports = globMatch. globMatch(pattern, str) returns true iff the WHOLE string matches the glob. Syntax: '*' matches any run of characters except '/'; '**' crosses '/' boundaries, and the pattern segment '**/' also matches zero directories (so 'a/**/b' matches 'a/b'); '?' matches exactly one non-'/' character; '[abc]' and '[a-z]' are character classes; a leading '!' or '^' inside the brackets negates the class; a backslash escapes the next character so it is matched literally. An unterminated '[' throws an Error, and so does a trailing backslash.
